reference: S5 starts reconciliation in the background and only logs incomplete reports; close waits for that task.
native: Construction remains lazy; the first successful open waits for reconciliation using the configured active namespace writer and host clock.
Row or registry errors reject open without registering or creating the requested agent; a later call retries against the same pinned pools.
The engine shutdown token cancels reconciliation and close serializes with open.
Existing S5 pending, missing-row and grace decisions remain unchanged; no restore grant, readiness or complete capture/Neo recovery is inferred.
